# Field

Connects a label, a hint and an error to the control inside it.

```tsx
import { Field } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- Around every Input, Textarea, Select, Slider, PinInput, TagInput or FileUpload.

## When not to

- Without a label: a placeholder is not a label.
- Hiding the label for looks: if the design cannot show it, name the control with `aria-label`.

## Examples

### Label, hint and error

The Field connects the label, the hint and the error to the control: no ids to repeat.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
  <Field label="Correo electrónico" hint="Te escribiremos aquí para confirmar la inscripción." required>
    <Input type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="nombre@correo.com" />
  </Field>
  <Field label="Teléfono" optional>
    <Input type="tel" autoComplete="tel" />
  </Field>
  <Field label="Documento" error="Escribe solo números, sin puntos." required>
    <Input defaultValue="12.345" inputMode="numeric" />
  </Field>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The visible label. Every control needs one. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` |  | Help text shown below the control and read with it. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` |  | Error message. Its presence marks the control as invalid and it is announced politely. |
| `required` | `boolean` |  | Marks the field as required: adds "(obligatorio)" to the label text and `aria-required` to the control. |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  | Adds "(opcional)" to the label. Use it in forms where most fields are required. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The control. Any Kafka control inside picks up its id, description and state. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **Label:** a real `<label for>` pointing at the control, so clicking it focuses the field.
- **Description:** hint and error are linked with `aria-describedby`.
- **Invalid:** an error sets `aria-invalid` on the control and is announced politely (a live region). The error has an icon as well as colour.
- **Required:** the label says "(obligatorio)" in text and the control gets `aria-required`; an asterisk alone is not enough.

## Content

- Say what to type, not what the field is: "Te escribiremos aquí para confirmar".
- Write the error as a fix: "Escribe solo números, sin puntos."
